items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: And that's why Thomas hired me a couple of times.

ctx.x: And Thomas came and heard Keller's Band and he heard you in the band.

Yeah, I heard me in the band. And that's why Thomas hired me a couple of times. And when I leave Keller's Band, I worked with Thomas. Then I and my brothers did work with Thomas. We worked there together. Him on sax and I'm on clown.
Oh, that was Paul. Paul. He played with Thomas too?

items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-07-29
items.q: Yeah I played pretty good with Thomas in the early days.

ctx.x: How about Kid Thomas in those days? Did you play much with Thomas in the early days?

Yeah I played pretty good with Thomas in the early days. I played cards with them quite a while. I don't remember Thomas having any other clarinet play. Just late, just a couple of years back, he's been having different one playing.
I don't remember anybody else playing clarinets. Always been saxophone playing with him lately.

items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1969-06-17
items.q: And now that Steve, he pulled out and went, you know, so I got Emile to play.

ctx.x: Tom, I'll tell you, I'm going to start the interview a little later. I saw a friend of yours today, Emile Barnes. We just saw him this morning. Yeah. Man, I seen Emile Barnes. When did you first start working with him? Can you remember?

Man, way back in, let me see. 19 what? 19... Run... Run 41, something like that. Uh-huh. Because I had that boy, what you call, playing with me, and then Steve, you know, Steve Angle. Steve Angle? Yeah, he was playing with me first head out there, you know what I mean? Yeah. And now that Steve, he pulled out and went, you know, so I got Emile to play.
That's the band on that photograph from that magazine. Yeah, yeah. Yeah, with T. Ruchon over there. Yeah, yeah. What time? Was that before World War II? Oh no.

items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-12-20
items.q: Now like Thomas is the manager of his band.

ctx.x: But both the manager and the assistant manager would be musicians playing in the band? In the band.
Both of them in the band. Now like Thomas is the manager of his band. Yeah.
Yeah, he's a manager. But I know what the rest is.
